name: PasswordAuthenticationV1
outputs: authenticated actor context or uniform AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS
setup_hash: validate password scalar-count and UTF-8 byte bounds without trimming, normalization or case conversion
require confirmation exact UTF-8 byte equality
argon2id hash with v=19,m=65536 KiB,t=3,p=4,output=32 bytes through argon2-cffi
persist PHC verifier only inside governing UnitOfWork
verify: apply current in-memory failure-delay gate before expensive hash
parse PHC only through pinned provider and reject unsupported algorithm/version/parameter shape as credential failure plus bounded diagnostic code
on mismatch increment per-run failure counter and return uniform AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS
on success clear failure counter and optionally flag needs_rehash only when an accepted future profile exists; Beta 1.0 profile is fixed

failure_delay.rule: delay occurs outside SQLite transactions and creates no durable account lockout

rules: password never derives/wraps DEK, backup key, run secret, session token or auto-login token
changing password cannot touch live DEK envelope or rekey database
malformed PHC is security-unavailable/configuration evidence internally but public login remains uniform
